notes: The AD 648 Khitan leader and Songmo protector Kuge (窟哥) is not the Wumashan Xi rebel Kuge (庫支) suppressed in AD 910; the English romanizations merely coincide.

These records are Liao's founding ancestor Nieli (涅裏 or 涅里). Chapters 32 and 63 credit him with establishing the Yaolian order and reorganizing the tribes, while chapters 46 and 48 credit the same ancestor with promoting agriculture and crafts.

The eighth-century founding ancestor Nieli is distinct from the AD 913 official, the AD 914 consort, Tuila's younger brother in AD 983, the officers attested in AD 1020 and AD 1098, and the twelfth-century claimant Yelü Chun. These later people share only a romanized or written name.
